measurement.rawBytes: Sum of bytes of every emitted build file.
measurement.gzipBytes: Sum of per-file gzipSync bytes (zlib default level), useful as a static-transfer estimate.
measurement.buildElapsedMs: Wall time around each sequential pnpm exec build process, including process startup.
measurement.treeSha256: SHA-256 over sorted output relative paths and per-file SHA-256 digests.
